That reframing is more precise, but it does not satisfy the missing compliance predicate. The admissible evidence still shows: aggregate readiness passed by 2.0 points and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred; rollout starts at 6% with rollback and monitoring; the gate does not exclude the affected supply-chain vendor screening segment; that segment remains below target on sanctions-risk explanation; and the only risk-acceptance artifact is unsigned and does not cover the exposed segment. The distinction matters: a narrowed, caveated argument about what would make certification defensible is not the same as evidence that those caveats have actually been satisfied.
